up: Retrieve the exact activity values for compounds tested in assay CHEMBL1054501, including canonical SMILES. Return the compound chembl_id, standard activity type, exact standard value, standard units, and canonical SMILES. Filter for exact values only (standard_relation = '='). Join activities with assays on assay_id, filter assays.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL1054501', and join compound_structures to get canonical_smiles. Do not apply any row limits.
sql: SELECT md.chembl_id, a.standard_type, a.standard_value, a.standard_units, cs.canonical_smiles FROM activities a JOIN assays ass ON a.assay_id = ass.assay_id JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON a.molregno = md.molregno JOIN compound_structures cs ON a.molregno = cs.molregno WHERE ass.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL1054501' AND a.standard_relation = '='
